description: Phase 3: Implement send_artist_instagram_preview function that sends an artist's Instagram preview to Telegram with photo + caption + inline keyboard buttons (Publish, Edit Caption, Replace Image, Regen Video 1/2), plus track preview videos as separate reply messages.

steps.task: Add helper function `build_artist_preview_keyboard(artist_id: i64, has_track1: bool, has_track2: bool) -> String` in telegram_notify.rs. Returns a JSON string representing an InlineKeyboardMarkup. Row 1: [📤 Publish] with callback_data `aig_pub:{id}`. Row 2: [✏️ Caption, 🖼 Image] with callback_data `aig_cap:{id}` and `aig_img:{id}`. Row 3 (only if tracks exist): [🎬 Video 1] and/or [🎬 Video 2] with callback_data `aig_vid:{id}:1` and `aig_vid:{id}:2`. Use serde_json::json! macro to build the structure and serde_json::to_string() to serialize.

decisions: Callback data prefix 'aig_' = artist instagram. Short to stay within Telegram's 64-byte limit
Video buttons only shown if the artist has tracks (track1_key / track2_key is Some)
learnings: Function placed at bottom of file after notify_stream_stop at line 1059

steps.task: Add `pub async fn send_artist_instagram_preview(state: &Arc<AppState>, artist: &models::Artist) -> Result<(), String>` in telegram_notify.rs.

decisions: Send photo as the main message with inline keyboard buttons
Caption uses instagram_caption (same text that will be posted to Instagram)
Use HTML parse_mode for consistency with other notifications
learnings: Best pic selection pattern: overlay → cropped → original — same as instagram.rs post_artist_to_instagram
download_file_bytes() is at lines 16-27 of telegram_notify.rs
storage::presigned_url() is available for getting R2 URLs
knowledge.notes: This function needs access to state.db for updating message IDs and state.config for bot token/chat_id. Use state.s3_client and state.config for presigned URLs.

steps.task: Extend send_artist_instagram_preview (step 2) to also send track preview videos as separate reply messages after the main photo. For each track (track1, track2): if artist has track{N}_video_key, download the video from R2 via presigned URL + download_file_bytes(), call send_video_raw() with a short caption like '🎵 Track {N}: {track_name}' and no reply_markup. Save returned message_id to artists.telegram_video{N}_message_id in DB.

decisions: Videos are separate messages (Telegram doesn't support mixed media + inline keyboard)
No inline buttons on video messages
Track video message IDs stored in DB for later in-place editing
Video failures log warning but don't fail the whole preview
learnings: Extracted helper send_track_video() at line 1217 for reuse
send_video_raw handles the download + send + message_id return
knowledge.notes: If video key exists but download fails, log warning and continue — don't fail the whole preview

steps.task: Run `cargo check` from source/backend/ to verify Phase 3 compiles. Fix any compilation errors.

learnings: cargo check passes with 18 warnings (15 pre-existing + 3 new dead-code for unused Phase 3 functions)
